source.providerName: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC EDGAR)
source.attribution: Source: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, company_tickers_exchange.json.
source.selectionPolicy: 950 unique CIK/name records, selected deterministically round-robin across Nasdaq and NYSE. Excludes blank/OTC venues and obvious ETF, ETN, ETP, fund, and trust names.

dataLimitations: SEC company_tickers_exchange.json maps SEC filers to ticker/exchange associations. It is not a global security master and does not guarantee accuracy or scope.
The source snapshot was last modified on 2026-07-24, so it is not a current listing-status check. All catalogue records remain unverified and require separate verification before any trading use.
countryCode describes the U.S. listing market, not the issuer's headquarters or domicile.
The source does not provide dependable sector, headquarters, logo, or instrument-type fields; these values are null rather than guessed.
Name-pattern filtering excludes common fund labels but does not prove every remaining issuer is an operating company; company-only use still requires manual review.
